title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The compiler guards the caches again
summary: The check the caches share accepted any object where a document was expected, and stored it. Nothing did that, but the compiler had stopped being able to say so.

highlights.title: A guard the compiler can enforce
highlights.description: The helper introduced last release was written loosely enough that passing something that is not a document compiled cleanly, and the cache entry then held it while still claiming to hold a document. Its signature ties the two together now.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: The behaviour of the check is unchanged, and is now pinned by a test for each of its three outcomes.
Two hundred thousand randomised runs confirm it answers correctly and only adopts the new document when the text really matches.
